task_completion.description: Load the GroEL-GroES complex (PDB ID: 1AON) into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '1AON' or the structure is visible in the viewer.

task_completion.description: Color GroES (O-U) yellow, cis ring (A-G) green, and trans ring (H-N) blue.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The molecular structure shows three distinct colored horizontal layers: yellow on top, green in the middle, and blue on the bottom.

task_completion.description: Apply a surface representation to the complex.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The molecule is shown as a solid molecular surface rather than sticks, ribbons, or cartoons.

task_completion.description: Apply a clipping plane (slab) to reveal the internal cavities.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The surface is sliced vertically, showing the hollow interior chambers of the GroEL rings.

task_completion.description: Measure the internal diameter of the cis and trans rings using Residue 261 CA atoms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Measurement dashed lines (labels) are visible in the PyMOL viewer connecting atoms across the internal cavities of both the green and blue rings.

task_completion.description: Write a report to ~/PyMOL_Data/groel_report.txt with the amino acid code, diameters, and difference.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a report containing the 3-letter code for residue 261, two diameter values in Å, and a calculated difference.

integrity.description: The agent used the PyMOL GUI or command line interface within the application.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL application window being active and manipulated, not just a static image viewer.

integrity.description: The agent performed actual distance measurements rather than hardcoding values.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PyMOL 'wizard' or 'distance' command output is visible in the PyMOL console/feedback area.

integrity.description: The agent saved the image and report to the specified paths.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal commands (ls) or file explorer views show the files existing at ~/PyMOL_Data/images/groel_chamber_sliced.png and ~/PyMOL_Data/groel_report.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1AON. Residue 261 is Glycine (GLY). The expected cis ring diameter (A:261:CA to D:261:CA) is approximately 75.7 Å (range 70-95 Å). The expected trans ring diameter (H:261:CA to K:261:CA) is approximately 38.5 Å (range 35-50 Å). The cis ring is significantly wider than the trans ring.
